args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted. 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
All three final checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) passed on every run. No run used the width-free ratio.
The summaries sit close to the batch. Centre REGR peak is 53.02–53.09 %/h, at 421 µm from the tip on every run. Growth-zone length is 674–695 µm.
The largest |z| values come from a very small batch MAD, and the differences behind them are small: r05 flank difference is -8.36 vs -8.075 %/h, and r02/r06/r08 flank difference position is 432 vs 415.5 µm.
r01 kept one remedy: frames registered on non-growing tissue before tracking, with stride 1, so the time base is unchanged. Its checks pass, so this is the normal path.
Since nothing was flagged, there is no common thread among flagged runs.
One thing to check: r03, r04 and r07 have the same check values and summaries, and so do r02, r06 and r08. Please confirm these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicate entries of the same movie, because duplicates would also make the batch MAD look smaller.
